message.content: Yes, ThaneChambers highly recommends Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice to those who enjoy a challenge. In a conversation with LiHua, he describes the game as "a challenging but rewarding experience," noting its unique combat system that requires careful timing and strategy. ThaneChambers mentions that the game is "all about timing and strategy" and that it offers an "epic adventure" for players who are up for the challenge. He also notes the engaging story, saying it has a "rich and great atmosphere," which can hook players quickly. Therefore, based on ThaneChambers' positive feedback, he indeed recommends Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice to fans of challenging games.
